name: Nude Shade Lipstick Pencil – High Pigment, Smooth Application & Long-Lasting Finish
description:
Nude Shade Lipstick Pencil – High Pigment, Smooth Application & Long-Lasting Finish
Enhance your natural beauty with our Nude Shade Lipstick Pencil, designed for effortless application and rich color payoff. Made with a smooth liquid-based formula, these high-pigmented pencils deliver intense nude shades that suit every skin tone. Whether you want a subtle everyday look or a defined, fuller lip effect, this lipstick pencil glides on easily, providing a long-lasting, smudge-resistant finish. Perfect for makeup artists and beauty lovers alike, this set ensures you always have the right nude tone for any occasion, Pack of 6 Random Shades.
Key Features:

 	High Pigment Formula: Delivers bold, true-to-color nude shades.
 	Liquid-Based Texture: Smooth, creamy glide for precise application.
 	Long-Lasting Wear: Stays put without smudging or fading.
 	Versatile Shades: Complements all skin tones and makeup looks.
 	Multi-Pack Value: Includes 12 pencils in various nude tones.
 	Compact & Portable: Easy to carry for touch-ups on the go.
 	Pack of 6 :  with random Shades
